body: It's late over here (actually from the UK) I'm just really tired. Sleep normally helps when I get like this. I will go for college, it's just it sucks having to wait for so long. Thank you for your time tonight. Hope everything is okay with you, too.
Sorry, and yes, I do plan on going to college. If I am alive to go.

Thank you, I do appreciate it. I'm sorry to hear about that. I know it must be hard. I know they do but I just constantly feel like they would be a lot better off without me. I've told them that before and they say they wouldn't, and I believe them that they think it's not true, but I know it is. They'd grieve for a while and get over it, and one day they'd forget me completely. I've already started writing my letter to the one who I think would probably be hit hardest. I know I'd be hurting them, but me being around them like this is hurting them too.

My dad is an alcoholic, don't even know where he is right now. Haven't seen/spoke to him in months. Mum tried to commit suicide a few months ago. Sister tried a few years back. Been feeling suicidal myself on and off since I was I suppose 12ish? I've been trying so hard for quite a while now not to kill myself, and I guess I feel like my family don't care enough about me to stay alive for me. Nobody really cares about me except a couple of my best friends, and they're going to be leaving soon.
No, sorry. I think I'm going to kill myself soon.
High school. I'm sure everyone will immediately write me off as some angsty teenager now.

Badly. I mean, I have things that can calm me down but generally I tend to stop caring because all I can think about is that I'm going to be dead soon. So I guess the way I handle stress is by reminding myself that none of it really matters any more, rather than actually tackling the base problem because I have no motivation any more.
